items.description: Disposal of shed roof timber and broken glass pane from shed (2 pcs)
items.rationale: Remains of the damaged insured shed are material arising under 5.2.1(a). Both materials are indemnifiable, so the combined position is covered under 7.1.10. Price level follows Cases 8 and 10 (glass about 30-34, timber below 75).

items.description: Combined clearance load: tree green waste, root mass over 1 m3, excavated soil (3 pcs)
items.rationale: It is a combined position mixing green waste (5.2.1(b)) with a root mass over 1 m3 (5.2.1(e)) and ground material (5.2.1(d)). Under 7.1.10 the whole position is declined, and no ground works under 5.2.2 apply because there is no reinstatement or making good.
Paving grit is ground material (1.3, 5.2.1(d)). Disposal as a standalone clearance measure with no reinstatement or making good is not indemnified under 5.2.2, so t = 0 (as in Case 8).

items.description: Disposal of sieved topsoil from churned-up ground
items.rationale: Topsoil is ground material (1.3, 5.2.1(d)). Standalone disposal without reinstatement of insured property or making good the ground is excluded under 5.2.2, so t = 0 (as in Cases 8 and 10).
